    examples:

  features:
    - or:

      - characteristic: tight loop
      - characteristic: recursive call

signature_matches.name: write file on Windows
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: write file on Windows
    namespace: host-interaction/file-system/write
    authors:
      - william.ballenthin@mandiant.com
      - anushka.virgaonkar@mandiant.com
    scope: function
    mbc:
      - File System::Writes File [C0052]
    examples:
      - Practical Malware Analysis Lab 01-04.exe_:0x4011FC
      # ntdll
      - 563653399B82CD443F120ECEFF836EA3678D4CF11D9B351BB737573C2D856299:0x1400025C4
  features:
    - or:
      - and:
        - os: windows
        - optional:
          - or:
            - and:
              - number: 0x40000000 = GENERIC_WRITE
              - api: kernel32.CreateFile
            - and:
              - number: 0x2 = FILE_WRITE_DATA
              - or:
                - api: NtCreateFile
                - api: ZwCreateFile
        - or:
          - api: kernel32.WriteFile
          - api: kernel32.WriteFileEx
          - api: NtWriteFile
          - api: ZwWriteFile
          - api: _fwrite
          - api: fwrite
      - api: System.IO.File::WriteAllBytes
      - api: System.IO.File::WriteAllBytesAsync
      - api: System.IO.File::WriteAllLines
      - api: System.IO.File::WriteAllLinesAsync
      - api: System.IO.File::WriteAllText
      - api: System.IO.File::WriteAllTextAsync
      - api: System.IO.File::AppendAllLines
      - api: System.IO.File::AppendAllLinesAsync
      - api: System.IO.File::AppendAllText
      - api: System.IO.File::AppendAllTextAsync
      - api: System.IO.File::AppendText
      - api: System.IO.FileInfo::AppendText

signature_matches.name: get local IPv4 addresses
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: get local IPv4 addresses
    namespace: host-interaction/network/address
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
      - joakim@intezer.com
    scope: function
    att&ck:
      - Discovery::System Network Configuration Discovery [T1016]

      - Practical Malware Analysis Lab 05-01.dll_:0x100037e6

            - number: 0 = AF_UNSPEC
            - number: 2 = AF_INET
            - number: 23 = AF_INET6

signature_matches.description: Sample execution stops while process was sleeping (likely an evasion)
PE file has an executable .text section and no other executable section
Sample might require command line arguments
PE file contains a mix of data directories often seen in goodware
Sample tries to load a library which is not present or installed on the analysis machine, adding the library might reveal more behavior
PE file has a high image base, often used for DLLs
Contains modern PE file flags such as dynamic base (ASLR) or NX

Sample may offer command line options, please run it with the 'Execute binary with arguments' cookbook (it's possible that the command line switches require additional characters like: "-", "/", "--")
Program does not show much activity (idle)
PE file contains a valid data directory to section mapping
Binary contains paths to debug symbols
PE file contains a debug data directory
URLs found in memory or binary data
